answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded, attested identity: each agent locks collateral behind a registry like a falcon flight log, where every claim of existence must be witnessed by a peer transaction. Trust reaches a zenith only through sustained observed work, and new identities start at the base of the mesa of reputation, accruing standing through witnessed outputs. For an attacker, each fake identity costs a full bond plus slashing risk if duplicates are flagged, so spawning thousands becomes a losing trade rather than free expansion.
